title: A Short Visit and a Weekend Plan · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写6—8句、至少40词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short message about a past visit and a future plan. Use was/were, be going to, and because. (Example: Last week, I was at my friend's house. We were happy. Next week, I am going to visit my aunt because it is her birthday.)
Write 6–8 complete sentences and at least 40 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
